Crepe_Spawn1: Master! Welcome! I was waiting... No, I am always standing by!
Crepe_Spawn2: I tidied up as much as I could! Please point out any place that is still dirty!
Crepe_Growth: I am Maid Crepe! My specialty is every kind of housework, and so is my hobby!
Crepe_Victory1: I shall begin cleaning! I will finish in no time!
Crepe_Victory2: Leave it to me! I will whisk everything away until it sparkles!
Crepe_Defeat1: All done. I cleaned everything just as you taught me.
Crepe_Defeat2: What do you think? It is clean now, is it not? Mr. Bed and Mr. Shelf are happy too.
Crepe_Die1: Have a safe trip, Master! Do not worry about the room while I am here!
Crepe_Die2: Are you busy again today? Stay strong!
Crepe_Touch1_1: Hmph, I am only letting this pass because I am a maid.
Crepe_Touch1_2: Huh? Why does it not hurt at all?
Crepe_Touch2: Did I do well today? Thank you!
Crepe_Touch2_2: You need to praise me even more!
Item_NPCSkin_Desc_Crepe_Skin1: It's Crepe, holding a toy hammer and dressed like a little chick. Anyone who dares to litter on the floor will hear the relentless sound of being bonked by it.
Crepe_Touch1_1_Skin1: I will bop you with my hammer.
Crepe_Touch2_1_Skin1: Is it not soft? So am I!
Crepe_Touch1_2_Skin1: You do not think I am dust, do you?
Crepe_Touch2_2_Skin1: I will keep cleaning diligently forever and ever!
Crepe_Defeat1_Skin1: Somehow, it felt as though I only stirred up more dust.
Crepe_Defeat2_Skin1: I will come back later and clean it properly.
Crepe_Die1_Skin1: I fought the squeaky hammer and won!
Crepe_Die2_Skin1: Haha! My shift is over! Time to go to sleep!
Crepe_Spawn1_Skin1: I will give the dust a good pounding.
Crepe_Spawn2_Skin1: Boing, let us go clean. Boing!
Crepe_Victory1_Skin1: I will beat all the dust out with my hammer.
Item_NPCSkin_Desc_Crepe_Skin2: After hearing someone say that her cleaning skills were "like magic," Crepe showed up dressed as a cleaning wizard. Determined to improve her cleaning magic, she practices diligently with her broom.
Crepe_Touch1_1_Skin2: Could you give your magic instruction with words...?
Crepe_Touch1_Skin2: Waah... Am I still not good enough?
Crepe_Touch2_1_Skin2: I'll practice even harder from now on!
Crepe_Touch1_2_Skin2: I'll grit my teeth and become a great wizard.
Crepe_Touch2_2_Skin2: It's like I see sparkles everywhere.
Crepe_Touch2_Skin2: Hehe... You are a great wizard too, aren't you, Master?
Crepe_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Uah! A-are you going to turn me into a frog?!
Crepe_Defeat1_Skin2: I swept away every speck of dust and scattered sparkles in its place.
Crepe_Defeat2_Skin2: Does this not make Crepe a dependable magician too?
Crepe_Die1_Skin2: I will be even more capable the next time you visit.
Crepe_Die2_Skin2: I will practice everything I learned today.
Crepe_Spawn1_Skin2: What spell shall I cast for you today?
Crepe_Spawn2_Skin2: Apprentice magician Crepe will accompany you again today.
Crepe_Victory1_Skin2: Allow me to show you cleaning that looks like magic.
Crepe_Victory2_Skin2: With a shimmer and a sparkle, Crepe will clean it all away.
Item_NPCSkin_Desc_Crepe_Skin3: Crepe wears a perfectly fitted nun's habit, saying she will bring the blessing of cleanliness to everyone. A bell rings whenever she cleans, and listening to it somehow brings peace to the heart.
Crepe_Touch1_1_Skin3: It hurts, but this too is one of Crepe's trials.
Crepe_Touch1_Skin3: Did Crepe make some kind of mistake?
Crepe_Touch2_1_Skin3: At this moment, I feel I could even show mercy to the honored pieces of trash.
Crepe_Touch1_2_Skin3: Is this another manifestation of your power, Master?
Crepe_Touch2_2_Skin3: I shall pray for your happiness, Master!
Crepe_Touch2_Skin3: I will work hard so that I can receive your praise more often.
Crepe_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: Will you not bestow your blessing upon me?
Crepe_Defeat1_Skin3: The honored pieces of trash are gone, and peace has returned.
Crepe_Defeat2_Skin3: Looking at a clean room makes my heart feel peaceful.
Crepe_Die1_Skin3: I shall pray that every object always shines!
Crepe_Die2_Skin3: Crepe will be returning to Crepe's home now.
Crepe_Spawn1_Skin3: May your day be free of even a single speck of dust!
Crepe_Spawn2_Skin3: A peaceful and happy cleaning time has arrived.
Crepe_Victory1_Skin3: Crepe shall bestow upon you the blessing called cleaning.
Crepe_Victory2_Skin3: I shall purify this space until it is spotless.
Crepe_Anger2: Why is everything such a mess?
Crepe_Anger3: I am a proper maid too!
Crepe_Pleasure2: Hold on, let me dust this real quick!
Crepe_Sorrow2: Things are not going as I imagined.
Crepe_Birthday: Happy birthday, Master! I will keep giving you the gift of a clean room!
Crepe_Greeting: Hello! I look forward to working with you again today!
Crepe_Line1: Queen Erpin is so clever... She always teaches me things I do not know as though they were easy!
Crepe_Line2: There is dust everywhere. Where does all this dust come from?
Crepe_Line3: I saw a dessert called a crepe recently... It was as cute as its name, so I liked it!
Crepe_End1: Everything is tidied away. I cleaned it thoroughly, just as I was taught.
Crepe_End2: I cleaned it thoroughly, just as I was taught.
Crepe_End3: For now, I have tidied up as much as I could.
Crepe_End4: What do you think? It is clean now, right?
Crepe_Start2: I will finish in no time!
Crepe_Start4: I'll clean it up nice and neat!
NPC_Desc_Crepe: A maid who resides at the Order and is in charge of cleaning and tidying up. There are many questions about her origins, but no one asks because she's so cute. She is excellent at her job and seems to have a soft heart.
